_comment: Capture settings for HAR filtering and compression

bloat_extensions._comment: File extensions to filter out during capture (reduces HAR size)

session_cookies._comment: Cookie names (case-insensitive full-match regexes) that indicate an already-established login session. Used by capture-completeness validation to detect a recording that began mid-session, where the auth exchange happened before the capture window opened.

password_fields._comment: POST-parameter name substrings (case-insensitive regexes) that mark a request as a credential submission. Used by capture-completeness validation to count login attempts; deliberately narrower than sensitive.json auto_redact_patterns (token/secret fields ride along on every form and would inflate the count).
